title: Dynamic target-ROI detector scheduling (pass-1 only, OFF flag)

implementation.planner: packages/swing-lab/src/paddleRoi.ts (pass1-roi-v1): ROI from BOTH target wrists over the detect span (W12: handedness never trusted), pad 0.15 norm, min wrist coverage 0.5, ROI > 0.8 of frame falls back
implementation.scope: PASS 1 (sparse scan) ONLY; pass 2 (dense, near contact) always full-frame; any plan abstention (empty span / insufficient wrist coverage / roi_not_smaller) falls back to untouched full-frame pass 1
implementation.provenance: plan recorded in paddle-schedule.json (pass1Roi); realized crop recorded by detect_paddle.py as roiNorm
implementation.tests: packages/swing-lab/test/paddleRoi.test.ts (7 cases) green; pnpm typecheck green; swing-lab suite 29/29 green

linuxCpuBench.zoneSourceDisclosure: pose is Apple-Vision-only, so the bench builds the zone from committed annotation paddleFrames points over the contact-centered 3 s window, padded 0.15 like production; the wrist-driven plan itself is unit-tested only

wallClockSaved.wm-volley-02: 0.160 s of 2.835 s (5.6%) over 24 stride-3 frames
wallClockSaved.afn-sasebo-rally1: 0.107 s of 3.618 s (3.0%) over 30 stride-3 frames
wallClockSaved.note: warmed-up runs; an earlier un-warmed run showed a fake 2.9 s saving that was pure cold-start ordering artifact and is disavowed

honestFindings: LATENCY MANDATE NOT MET BY ROI ALONE ON THIS PIPELINE: the D-FINE processor resizes every input to a fixed 640x640 (do_resize=True), so cropping to ~23% of the frame does NOT shrink model compute — only decode/preprocess. Measured wall-clock saving is 3.0-5.6%, not the large win ROI implies on resolution-proportional pipelines.

AGREEMENT IS NOT ~EQUAL INSIDE THE ZONE: cropping acts as a zoom (different effective resolution), so detections differ. High-score (>=0.3, track-establishing) match rate inside the ROI is 79.1% / 78.4%; down to the 0.08 tracker floor it is 47.2% / 36.7% with mean IoU ~0.77 of matches and mean |score delta| 0.13-0.16. The ROI runs also produce extra detections (zoom finds more small boxes).

Whether the changed pass-1 evidence helps or hurts the tracker/cascade cannot be judged here: downstream cascade validation is Mac-gated (pose extraction is Apple-Vision-only and canonical run dirs are absent on Linux).
recommendation: Keep --pass1-roi OFF. The flag, planner, provenance and tests are in place; before enabling, either pair ROI with a resolution-proportional inference path (so the crop shrinks compute) or re-evaluate on-device (Core ML/ANE) where fixed-size resize may not dominate, then run Mac-gated cascade validation.
